acceptance: Each of tpch/polars-df sf0.01, tpch/polars-df sf0.1 and tpch/datafusion sf1.0 has a recorded decision (fix, remove, or keep with a reason); the datafusion failure cause is confirmed from the job log
If a cell is removed: a workflow test beside tests/unit/workflows/test_seed_corpus_pr_base.py asserts the matrix no longer lists it
If a cell is kept as expected-ineligible: a test shows a fixture bundle with summary.validation uncertain is not staged into the seed PR
The next Seed Corpus run needs no manual bundle drops, or the remaining drops are listed in the PR body by the workflow
context: Raised by the 2026-10-13 adversarial review (handoff revision 9, blind spots). Evidence: run 38331461283 job list shows tpch / datafusion / sf1.0 failure; PR #2930 commit a341576e3 "drop run-3093 bundles with mirror-ineligible validation"; precedent for dropping uncertain bundles is #2494. Low priority; does not block the pipeline fix.
description:
In Seed Corpus run 38331461283 both tpch/polars-df bundles validated uncertain (structural translation fallback) and were dropped from PR #2930 by hand, and tpch/datafusion/sf1.0 failed on the runner (reported as an out-of-memory failure at Q18; not independently checked). The matrix will keep producing the same output, so each seed PR needs the same manual cleanup.

Decide per cell: fix the cause, mark it expected-ineligible so its bundle is not committed, or remove it from the matrix.
